scope: Proposition 10.1 (Visit recursion and nesting comparison) of the manuscript “Disk transfer representations and confined bridge mass” (preprints/Disk-transfer-representations-and-confined-bridge-mass-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d64dc634fe49d994), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 64. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every finite filled D and v ∈ D, T(v, D) = 3 + ∑ Γ⊂D v∈Γ 2x|Γ|−1[ − cos ( s(2π − τv(Γ)) )] + ∑ Γ⊂D v∈Γ◦ 2x|Γ| T(v, Γ◦ ). (10.3) Every coefficient on the right is positive. In particular, T(v, D) ≥ 3 and T(v, D) is monotone under inclusion of finite filled sets containing v. There are absolute positive constants such that T(v, D) ≍ ∑ f incident to v Z(D; f). (10.4) If D is the vertex set inside a bounded convex polygon cut out by admissible walls, and AD(v) denotes the corresponding positive, ordered excursion weight through v, then cos(3π/8)AD(v) ≤ T(v, D) ≤ AD(v). (10.5)
